parameters.name: AssureDirection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the image direction is confirmed to be upright. Valid values:
- true: The image is upright.
- false: The image is not upright.

parameters.name: HasLine
parameters.description:
Specifies whether the table has no lines. Valid values:
- true: The table has no lines or has only horizontal lines without vertical lines.
- false: The table has lines.

parameters.name: ImageURL
parameters.description: The URL of the image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) link in the Shanghai region. If the file is stored locally or in an OSS bucket outside the Shanghai region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: OutputFormat
parameters.description: The output format is `json`. (`html` and `xlsx` are deprecated. If you set this parameter to `html` or `xlsx`, the output is still in JSON format.).

parameters.name: SkipDetection
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to skip detection. Valid values:
- true: Skip detection.
- false: Do not skip detection.

parameters.name: UseFinanceModel
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to use the financial statement model. Valid values:
- true: Use the financial statement model.
- false: Do not use the financial statement model.
